title: Planner Agent in Copilot Chat: task assignment, scheduled catch-up and memory
summary: Hold: the briefing says catch-up email notifications are not a charge, but the supplied notice and Microsoft documentation do not establish that pricing claim. The pinning path also omits the menu needed to reach Manage pinned agents on the cited Learn page; the rollout dates, default state and licence requirement are supported.

claims.where: front matter: risk; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A medium risk rating fits this default-on agent change with write access and coarse controls.
claims.quote: risk: "medium"; "This is a default-on change to an agent that can write to shared plans." The assessment scale says "an on-by-default agent with write access is high".
claims.fix: Set risk to high and start its rationale with 'High.': the change is default-on, can write assignments to shared plans and has coarse controls. Retain the user-confirmation and existing-permissions qualifications as mitigations.

claims.where: front matter: impact; rationale: impact
claims.claim: A medium impact rating fits the change to default behavior for all licensed users with Planner Agent access.
claims.quote: impact: "medium"; "Every user with a Microsoft Copilot licence and access to Planner Agent sees the new behaviour". The assessment scale defines high impact as "most users, or a change to default behaviour".
claims.fix: Set impact to high and start its rationale with 'High.': the additions change default behavior for all licensed users who already have Planner Agent access; keep that audience qualification.
